title: F28 · fathers_chair · His Father's Chair
lines: His father sat in that chair for forty years. Nobody has sat in it since.
He was at a wedding in another city when the call came.
There were things he meant to say. He was always going to say them next week.
That night the moon was a thin, last sliver.
It is not gone. It is in my keeping.
In the morning Papa sat down in the chair.
He said the things out loud, to the shop, while he opened the shutter.
What you did not say can still be said. They are kept. That is sadhana.
